narrative:
Operating costs were £84.6M in FY2025 (including a £2.2M motor finance commission redress provision) and the cost-income ratio improved to 48.8%. The FY2026 budget is £91.9M including depreciation; the 9+3 forecast is £88.1M, a cost-income ratio of 46.9%.

Costs are planned by cost centre × account × entity across ten cost centres. Technology, data and change is the largest non-staff line (£9.0M of platforms and licences) and IT change spend is front-loaded into H2 2026 with the lending-platform release.

The year-to-date under-run of £2.8M is mostly phasing — £1.8M lands in Q4.
